caption:
India waited for a crisis to fix its economy. Are you doing the same with your money? 👀

In 1991, India was running out of foreign exchange and had to pledge its gold before opening up its economy.

And we often follow the same pattern with personal finances.

We build an emergency fund after an emergency. Buy health insurance after a hospital bill. Start investing when a financial scare hits.

But financial security isn’t built during a crisis. It’s built before one.

You can’t control when a crisis hits. You can control how prepared you are.

Save this post and take one step towards securing your finances before your next payday.
